statements.status_notes: Debian fixed this for trixie in libevent 2.1.13-stable-1~deb13u1 (DSA-6493-1), which ships the upstream 2.1.13-stable point release, and the DHI build of that Debian version carries the fix. Upstream commit https://github.com/libevent/libevent/commit/377b9022c3ac61aa4540b5dc4b70c60bf74c663d makes dnsname_to_labels return an error when the terminating zero byte would land at buf_len, instead of writing one byte past the buffer. Checked by inspecting the DHI Debian packages on amd64 and arm64 with their debug symbols. The disassembly of dnsname_to_labels in the libevent-2.1 and libevent-extra-2.1 shared libraries contains the added length comparison before that write, which builds without the fix lack. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-63387 and https://github.com/libevent/libevent/security/advisories/GHSA-58rx-7448-jw47.
